rationale: Reject the nearest D elevator as Entrance A identity using independent WMATA descriptions/map and distinct OSM entrance references; record supported A/B/D matches without modifying source coordinates.

record.notes: Desktop identity review: Entrance A matches existing railway entrance node 324153442 (ref=A), near 7th and F, with access footway 1341673975. The WMATA source description and vicinity-map escalator location support this identity. The research reference is 80.7 m from A but 37.1 m from elevator entrance D (node 9951151070). The automated assignment to D is an identity mismatch for this source description; it is not evidence that A is missing. Do not merge A and D or add a duplicate entrance. All four entrance nodes are members of station stop-area relations 359558 and 7945932 in the recorded snapshot. Evidence: https://www.wmata.com/content/dam/wmata-com/maps/Rail%20Station%20Vicinity%20Maps/Gallery%20Place_vicinity-map.pdf ; https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/324153442 ; https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/359558 ; docs/evidence/gallery-place-2026-10-16.json. No source coordinates changed; no OSM edit approved.

Desktop identity review: Entrance B matches existing railway entrance node 9951151069 (ref=B), with access ways 1428204806 (steps/conveying) and 1428209233 (sidewalk), on the 9th and G side shown by WMATA. The research reference is 56.2 m away. Name/reference, street-side agreement and access geometry support the match; distance alone would not. All four entrance nodes are members of station stop-area relations 359558 and 7945932 in the recorded snapshot. Evidence: https://www.wmata.com/content/dam/wmata-com/maps/Rail%20Station%20Vicinity%20Maps/Gallery%20Place_vicinity-map.pdf ; https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/9951151069 ; https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/359558 ; docs/evidence/gallery-place-2026-10-16.json. No source coordinates changed; no OSM edit approved.

Desktop identity review: Entrance D elevator matches node 9951151070 (ref=D, railway=subway_entrance, highway=elevator, wheelchair=yes), connected to sidewalk way 1102459367 at the arena frontage. The WMATA map shows a separate elevator north of the A escalator on 7th Street between F and G. Source description says 7th and G; this is retained verbatim rather than used to invent a replacement coordinate. Its research-reference distance is 39.3 m. The shared automated candidate with A is valid for D, not A. This confirms mapped elevator identity, not current operation or a complete accessible route. All four entrance nodes are members of station stop-area relations 359558 and 7945932 in the recorded snapshot.
